content: Apply the user-authorized breaking addendum to D0029 through SC0007. Force-settle every schema version 1 session by deleting its detailed current-tree ledger after $roast verifies that only already-promoted medium and dark claims remain in canonical owners; retain only compact ID tombstones and the source Git revision as non-executable administrative resolution. Revisions 8247105738bfc962354d3e30f9041ab3a32d4b3e and 47bab198be8241c6c01a501056da5e74ca8d6522 established and then permanently enforced the schema version 2 / D0029 execution boundary. Agent records, 189 self-test cases, semantic-change 21/21, and commit-identity 7/7 passed before P20260901-091. Legacy detail liquidation and the medium/dark canonical-owner audit remain the next migration unit.

Revision 97248239d507028309df07aaa4d1f462388cf4b6 completed the authorized destructive settlement: 82 schema version 1 sessions and 330 tracked detail files were removed, 72 transient guidance files were deleted, and 20 links across 17 checkpoints were redirected to the strict administrative tombstone. The pre-liquidation roast audit preserved only 72 medium and 24 dark mappings through 62 existing canonical owners; no old objective, event, note, summary, output, light roast, session-only detail, or compatibility path remains in the current tree.

Apply SC0007 at effective revision 97248239d507028309df07aaa4d1f462388cf4b6, close this governance owner, and transfer product focus atomically to S0112-20260901-001-m0110-w0112-current-epoch.
